blocks.text: A sense of hope swept through Belgrade on Thursday evening as thousands gathered for the final rally of the Student List, the group of candidates put forward by the student movement that has been protesting against the government for almost exactly two years. The Student List is calling for an end to the current regime in Serbia via the ballot box in Sunday’s parliamentary election.
